full_page.content:
1936, December
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 159 Cont.
Dec. 29 Francis Burkel - 9 - fearful kidney in Saratoga Hospital.
Mrs. Albert Richer - 33 - T.B. going to sanitorium - has 3 children & husband - hopes in your prayers ..
Page 160
Dec. 31 Mrs. Potrykus - 65 - Gall-stones and probably cancer of stomach ... Mrs. Fr. Lidle - 52 - trying to pay debts.
Rose and Anne Cowan - 43 -45 - not well - years ago their mother - in serious - prayed if ....
January 1937
1937, January
Jan. Wm. Campbell - 11-14 - injured at birth, has no control of his limbs - Drs. say will never have. Has a brilliant mind otherwise.
2 Margaret Dysarz - 21 - T.B. still at home with mother. ...
4 High-school gratuate J.S. - 17 - vanished five week last Saturday - Nov. 28 no trace of him since.
Frank Bock - 31 - fell 15 to 18 feet breaking both heel-bones -opera- tion next Thursday. This man was in insane asylum for two years and 3 mo. when prayers were requested for him and he was enrolled in S. M.A ... has been O.K. 22 yrs. and working every day.
Hector Roels - 28 - a teacher (in Jackson Pr.) would like to get something to do - to be parolled. Mother add. 1782 Meldrum
Page 161
Jan. 5 Marie Dimmin - 25 - T.B. removal of right lung arranged for to-morrow 6th. Enrolled last Friday, when believed to be dying .... "something kept me alive" she remarked afterwards ....
6 Mrs. Hoffman - about 50 - serious stomach trouble and neck pains. Fr. Cook n. Cath - about 40 - pneumonia last spring ... Babbara Podkachzewski - hard of hearing - better hearing.
